indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving long-term government contracts consistently awarded, through an opaque selection process, to the same legal entity or entities that share similar beneficial ownership structures.
indicators.red_flag: Repeat opaque-tender award to common-UBO entity cluster (procurement capture)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving services provided to state-owned companies or public institutions by companies registered in high-risk jurisdictions.
indicators.red_flag: State-entity vendor incorporated in high-risk jurisdiction (corridor anomaly)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving official embassy or foreign government business conducted through personal accounts.
indicators.red_flag: Government/embassy business routed through personal accounts (account-type mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving public officials related to high-value assets, such as real estate or other luxury goods, that are not commensurate with the reported source of wealth for the public official or that fall outside that individual’s normal pattern of activity or lifestyle.
indicators.red_flag: PEP high-value-asset spend exceeding declared source-of-wealth (lifestyle mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving public officials and funds moving to and from countries with which the public officials do not appear to have ties.
indicators.red_flag: PEP flows to/from no-nexus jurisdictions (corridor anomaly)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Use of third parties to shield the identity of foreign public officials seeking to hide the origin or ownership of funds, for example, to hide the purchase or sale of real estate.
indicators.red_flag: Third-party proxy concealing PEP ownership of funds/property (nominee shielding)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C17 (PEP & sanctioned-elite proxy screening).

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Documents corroborating transactions involving government contracts (e.g., invoices) that include charges at substantially higher prices than market rates or that include overly simple documentation or lack traditional details (e.g., valuations for good and services).
indicators.red_flag: Government-contract invoice over-pricing / thin documentation (documentary anomaly)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving payments that do not match the total amounts set out in the underlying documentation, or that involve vague payment details or the use of old or fraudulent documentation to justify transfer of funds.
indicators.red_flag: Payment-vs-supporting-document mismatch with stale/fraudulent paperwork (documentary anomaly)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Transactions involving fictitious email addresses and false invoices to justify payments, particularly for international transactions.
indicators.red_flag: Fictitious-email / false-invoice justification for cross-border payment (BEC-style documentary fraud)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.section: Financial Red Flag Indicators of Kleptocracy and Foreign Public Corruption
indicators.flag: Assets held in the name of intermediate legal entities whose beneficial owner or owners are tied to a kleptocrat or his or her family member.
indicators.red_flag: Assets held via intermediate entities with kleptocrat-linked UBO (shell-layer concealment)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.
